text:
Alex: heads up 1: noticed p99 jump on /generate in eu-west after yesterday's routing tweak. console: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency-eu-west :eyes:
Mira: yep saw it. p50/p95 fine, p99 +120ms. raw samples look small for p99 though
Priya: which routing change? my hunch is fallback weight increase sending more requests to quantized model
Alex: changed primary weight 0.9 -> 0.6, fallback 0.1 -> 0.4 at 02:30UTC (autoscaler policy roll)
Dan: that fits. model-v2-quant has similar median but heavier tail on KV cache miss / long sequences
Mira: traces: ~70% of p99 traces include model-v2-quant and show kvcache_miss on first token
Alex: router log snippet:
```
[02:30:12] route_assign svc=svc123 route=eu-west weight=0.6 fallback=0.4
[02:30:13] model_select req=abcd model=model-v2-quant
[02:30:14] kvcache_miss key=prefix_user_...
```
Priya: bench earlier showed p95 ok, but p99 degrades for seq >512. didn't expect endpoint p99 to move much
Dan: two amplifiers: more fallback hits + cold-kvcache warmup pattern
Mira: also possible the p99 is noisy: our rollup merges tdigest shards and low sample counts make tails unstable
Alex: raw sample counts for last hour: p99 used ~180 samples, p95 used ~12k -> p99 noisy indeed
Priya: so mix of real effect and stats noise. we should surface sample-count next to p99
Dan: immediate plan:
- rollback route weight to 0.9 (Alex)
- add sample-count badge and low-sample warning on p99 (Mira)
- add per-model percentile split for endpoints (Priya)
- run KV priming on canary to validate tail behavior (Dan)
Alex: also annotate the dashboard with the routing change for provenance
Mira: UX: warning if p99 sample_count < 500 -> yellow badge "p99 may be unstable: low sample count"
Priya: add route table column "fallback-hit-rate" to correlate routing -> latency shifts
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Received request from Alex. Initiating rollback: route eu-west primary weight -> 0.9
Alex: monitoring now. will post a short incident timeline to #incidents
Priya: note for product: quota/backoff policies that route to cheaper variants can increase endpoint tails; document tradeoffs for routing owners
Dan: long-term: console should show per-model, per-variant percentiles and provenance (route weight, fallback rate, kvcache-hit-rate) in latency pane
Mira: I'll mock the sample-badge and open a PR after rollback validates
Alex: follow-up: postmortem to include routing policy change, sample counts, per-variant tails, and console UX changes.
Priya: ACK
Dan: ACK :thumbsup:
Mira: moving to create dashboard annotation + small UX PR
Alex: thanks all. watch window 10m to confirm p99 drop
